Member email | Finch Lane Chess Circle
Subject: Two clock trials at Thursday's meetup

On Thursday, two tables will try a clock display that shows both players' remaining time in larger figures. The two trial tables will use the same game length as the other tables. Players can ask for the larger display without entering the tournament; the room stays open for friendly games. Our score slips record a game as a loss on time when a player’s clock runs out; that entry describes the result, whether or not the player could read the display. Our test sheet uses two seat letters because one seat catches a reflection from the hall lamp and the other does not.

One display also turns red when a player has two minutes left. The other keeps the same color throughout. Both displays show the same numerical time, and a volunteer will record which display each player starts with. We are asking about legibility, not whether the red signal changes playing speed, so try to report the two features [143] _____. At last week’s setup game, Nia’s opponent won. Afterward, Nia told us she had read every number from her seat without asking her opponent to check the clock. In the test setting, once the warning comes on it stays on until we reset the clock, even if we add time.

We can enlarge the figures on the red-warning clock without moving it. To see what difference size makes, we asked Asha to read the clock at both settings before the evening games. We left it in one place and recorded each reading with 3:00 showing. Asha’s smaller-figure reading came from H during a fresh countdown. The large-figure readings were at H after adding time back from 1:40, at J counting down after a reset, and at H counting down after a reset. [144] _____

The larger display is not part of the official competition timetable. Anyone whose game runs past the volunteer's shift can leave feedback on the signup clipboard. The equipment is due back before the hall closes on Thursday. The comments will be read at nine the next morning, [145] _____ the equipment loan will have ended.

On the clipboard, Nia wrote, “That one was a win for me.” She was referring to last week’s setup game. Rob turned in a score slip marked “lost on time” and left the comments box blank. There is room for one line about the two notes in the morning summary. [146] _____

會員郵件｜芬奇巷西洋棋社
主旨：星期四聚會的兩種時鐘試用

星期四有兩張棋桌會試用新款時鐘，以較大的數字顯示雙方剩餘時間。試用桌與其他棋桌的對局時間相同。棋友不用報名比賽就可申請大字顯示；場地仍開放自由對弈。 棋友的時間用完時，成績單會記為超時落敗。那一欄記的是對局結果，與棋友能不能讀清時鐘無關。 我們在測試表上用兩個字母標記座位，因為其中一個座位看得到會場燈具的反光，另一個則看不到。

其中一款在任一棋友剩兩分鐘時會變成紅色，另一款全程顏色不變。兩款皆顯示同樣的時間數字，志工會記錄每位棋友起初使用哪一種。這次要了解是否易讀，不是要看紅色訊號會不會影響下棋速度，因此請將這兩種功能[143] _____回報。 上週場地準備時那場棋由妮雅的對手獲勝。她賽後告訴我們，坐在原位就能看清所有數字，不必請對手幫忙確認時間。 在測試模式下，一旦變紅，即使手動加回時間，也要重設時鐘才會恢復原色。

亮紅色警示的那款時鐘不用搬動，就能把數字放大。想知道字體大小有何影響，我們在晚間對局前請阿莎讀兩種大小的顯示。時鐘固定在同一位置，每筆讀取時都顯示剩三分鐘。阿莎的小字基準是在 H 座，當時是新一輪倒數。大字有三筆：在 H 座，從一分四十秒手動加回三分鐘；在 J 座，重設後倒數；以及在 H 座，重設後倒數。[144] _____

大字顯示試用不屬於正式賽程。若對局超過志工值班時間，棋友可在報名夾板上留言。設備必須在星期四會場關閉前歸還。隔天早上九點會查看留言；[145] _____，設備的借用期限就已結束。

妮雅在夾板上留言：「對我來說，那場算是贏了。」她指的是上週場地準備時下的那場棋。羅布繳回一張寫著「超時落敗」的成績單，意見欄則留白。早上的摘要只能用一行整理這兩份紀錄。[146] _____
